# Ink

Behavior JIT for production AI. Ink turns repeated, verified model decisions
into local Fast Paths with automatic fallback and deoptimization.

The Python SDK exposes Ink, DecisionSite, DecisionResult, FallbackResult,
Outcome, PromotionRequirements, decision, record_outcome, CandidateSite,
discover_from_file, and discover_from_traces. The CLI exposes ink discover,
ink sites, ink status, ink inspect, ink compile, ink evaluate, ink maintenance,
ink value, ink export, ink retain, ink model-install, and ink model-train.

Install: pip install ink-jit
Import: from ink import DecisionSite, Ink, FallbackResult

Read README.md, docs/integration.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/cli.md,
docs/concepts.md, docs/compatibility.md, docs/discovery.md, docs/claims.md,
docs/production-safety.md, docs/security-data-handling.md, docs/deployment.md,
docs/threat-model.md, docs/value-model.md, docs/alternatives.md,
docs/pii-guidance.md, and examples/refund_agent/README.md.

Local-first, explicit sites, conservative exact-state coverage, independent outcome
verification, randomized fallback comparison, and explicit maintenance. No cloud,
dashboard, workflow mining, or automatic framework attachment.
